newsitem.title: USA: Toshiba's new computer to boost FY97 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba's new computer to boost FY97 EPS.

text.p: Toshiba Corp's first line of home personal computers, the Infinia line, is expected to boost earnings per share by $0.25 in fiscal year 1997, Shunki Yatsunami, president of Toshiba America Information Systems Inc, said Tuesday.

Tom Scott, general manager of the computer systems division at Toshiba America, said the company planned to sell 250,000 PC units in the first six months of calendar 1997 and one million by the end of 1997.
Toshiba said the Infinia line uses Intel Corp's Pentium 133 MHz, Pentium 166 MHz and Pentium 200 MHz chips and has hard drives ranging up to 3 gigabytes.

The line also has 16 MB or 32 MB standard EDO memory, expandable to 128 MB, as well as a 28.8 kilobits per second modem with software upgradable to 33.6 kilobits per second and Digital Simultaneous Voice Data capabilities.
